name: inflammatory bowel disease overview
title: Inflammatory bowel disease decision chart: Crohn's disease (skip lesions, transmural, anywhere in the gut) split into medical disease and its stricturing or fistulizing complications, and ulcerative colitis (continuous from the rectum, mucosal) split by severity into mild to moderate and severe or fulminant disease; each column gives presentation, numbered investigations and treatment in order

root.title: Chronic diarrhea, pain, bleeding, weight loss: inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), and CROHN'S or ULCERATIVE COLITIS?
lines: flares and remissions · peak 20s–30s, second peak 50s–70s · rule out INFECTION first (stool tests)
colonoscopy + BIOPSY makes the diagnosis in both
BOTH: follow up every 3 months (bloodwork, side effects) · colorectal cancer risk ↑: see the COLORECTAL CANCER SCREENING lecture

groups.title: SKIP lesions · TRANSMURAL · mouth to anus: CROHN'S
lines: terminal ileum most often · smoking makes it WORSE

groups.title: CONTINUOUS from the RECTUM · MUCOSAL: ULCERATIVE COLITIS
lines: colon only · how many stools a day sets the severity

head: h
Crohn's disease
granulomas, deep fissuring ulcers
pres: erythema nodosum, oral ulcers, eye inflammation, arthritis
inv: C-reactive protein (CRP), fecal calprotectin, ferritin, albumin, ↓ B12
tx: 5-aminosalicylic acid (5-ASA) works in only a few

head: h
Crohn's complications
from the transmural, fissuring ulcers
tx: 2 · Surgery: up to half need it

head: h
Ulcerative colitis: mild to moderate
mild < 4 stools a day, normal CRP
moderate ≥ 4, little toxicity
pres: pyoderma gangrenosum, ankylosing spondylitis, primary sclerosing cholangitis
tx: CURATIVE: dysplasia, cancer, poor quality of life

head: h
Ulcerative colitis: severe or fulminant
risk of TOXIC MEGACOLON
pres: > 6 bloody stools + fever, tachycardia, anemia or ↑ CRP
> 10 stools, continuous bleeding, distension, needs transfusion
tx: 2 · Not responding, perforation, megacolon: EMERGENCY SURGERY
